correctnessGate.enforcement: Hard stop: Any candidate violating correctness is immediately rejected.

onlineLatencyGate.enforcement: Online evaluation must report zero deadline violations on registered test panels.

fallbackSanityGate.enforcement: A candidate that relies excessively on fallback (>5%) is disqualified from promotion.

qualityPromotionCriteria.screeningThreshold: +5.0 percentage points natural win rate improvement against reference baseline
qualityPromotionCriteria.formalPromotionThreshold: Lower bound of 95% confidence interval of paired win rate delta > 0.0, OR lower bound >= -2.0 percentage points with at least 20% lower median decision latency and no tail latency degradation.

evidenceThresholds.holdCondition: Sample size too small to resolve 95% confidence interval, or natural game terminations < 20
evidenceThresholds.noGoCondition: Inferior natural win rate or regression on tactical fixtures
